import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static long total_sum_result = 0;
    static long total_n_value;
    static long count1_var = 0;
    static long[] sum_levels = new long[7];
    static List<Long>[] level_vectors = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] power_ten_arr = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            level_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate_levels(long level, long prefix) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        level_vectors[(int) level].add((count1_var - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1);
        sum_levels[(int) level] += (count1_var - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1;
        count1_var++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generate_levels(level + 1, prefix * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static boolean check_range(long x) {
        final long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999 <= total_n_value && x * limit * 10 > total_n_value;
    }

    static long count2 = -1;

    static void search(long level, long number) {
        if (number > total_n_value) return;
        if (check_range(number)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long current = ((count2 + 1 - (number * power_ten_arr[i]) % MOD1) + MOD1) % MOD1;
                List<Long> vec = level_vectors[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(vec, MOD1 - current);
                long size = vec.size();
                long sum_level = sum_levels[i];
                long contribution = sum_level + current * size - MOD1 * (size - pos);
                total_sum_result = (total_sum_result + contribution) % MOD2;
            }
            count2 += count1_var;
        } else {
            count2++;
            total_sum_result = (total_sum_result + ((count2 - number) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                search(level + 1, number * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_n_value = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generate_levels(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(level_vectors[i]);
        }
        count2 = -1;
        search(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total_sum_result);
    }
}
